Made by nuns at a remote abbey in 16th-century France, in the heart of the famed Jura region, Galant des Abbesses is now exclusively produced by 15th-generation French winemakers Jean Bourdy and his brother according to the same secret recipe. We’re fortunate to be one of only a handful of restaurants in Chicago to serve Galant des Abbesses. It stars in our cocktail, On An Autumn Wind. On its own, it smells like autumn in a glass. Experience it for yourself.
